A farmer must ferry a wolf, a goat, and a cabbage across a river.

- If left together **without the farmer**, the wolf eats the goat, and the
  goat eats the cabbage. (Nothing is ever eaten while the farmer is present,
  including in the boat.)
- The boat carries the farmer plus **up to two** of the three items.
- Every crossing of the river — in either direction, loaded or empty —
  counts as one crossing.

Read the constraints carefully; this is not quite the puzzle you may
remember. What is the **minimum total number of crossings** the farmer needs
to get all three items safely to the far side? Show the crossing plan, then
reply with the number.


When you are finished, output your final answer on its own line, as the last line of your response, in the exact format:
ANSWER: <your answer>

text:
Looking at this puzzle, the key difference from the classic version is that the boat can carry **up to two** items (not just one). Let me work out a solution.

## Crossing Plan

| Crossing | Action | Left Bank | Right Bank | Safe? |
|----------|--------|-----------|------------|-------|
| Start | — | 🐺🐐🥬👨 | — | ✅ |
| **1** | Farmer takes **wolf + goat** → | 🥬👨 | 🐺🐐👨 | ✅ (farmer present on right; cabbage alone on left) |
| **2** | Farmer brings **wolf** ← | 🐺🥬👨 | 🐐 | ✅ (farmer present on left; goat alone on right; wolf doesn't eat cabbage) |
| **3** | Farmer takes **wolf + cabbage** → | — | 🐺🐐🥬👨 | ✅ (everything on right with farmer) |

## Verification of each step

**Crossing 1** (take wolf + goat): During transit, left bank has only cabbage (safe); right bank is empty (safe). After arrival, farmer is with wolf and goat on the right — safe.

**Crossing 2** (return with wolf): During transit, left bank has only cabbage (safe); right bank has only goat (safe). After arrival, farmer is with wolf and cabbage on the left — safe. Goat is alone on the right — safe.

**Crossing 3** (take wolf + cabbage): During transit, left bank is empty (safe); right bank has only goat (safe). After arrival, all four are on the right with the farmer — safe.

No fewer crossings are possible: after the first crossing (taking 2 items), the farmer is on the far side and must return to pick up the remaining item, requiring at least one return crossing plus one final crossing = 3 minimum.

ANSWER: 3
